name: Ma 2019 Sci China 2.65 K hybrid JT, measured point

reference.citation: Ma Y X, Quan J, Wang J, et al. A closed loop 2.65 K hybrid JT cooler for future space application. Sci China Tech Sci 62(2) (2019) 361-364
reference.location: Table 2 (precool 64.5/14.6 K, Ph 0.6 MPa); text: eta 97.2/97.3/97.2 %, mdot 1.2 mg/s, 1.48 mW at 2.71 K
reference.note: He-4 via CoolProp. Measured mdot is used (their orifice: 2 x 30 um in series, not modelled). Our model has no heat leak and no return-line pressure drop, so Q_C should come out higher than the measured 1.48 mW; their return pressure was 12 kPa at the compressor, ~13.3 kPa at the evaporator.
